method: Native application screenshots captured through CUA from the unmodified published v1.6 JAR. A temporary jpackage app launcher enabled native app targeting; the JAR was neither rebuilt nor modified. Synthetic sample contacts only.
window: Main window 1000 x 720 logical pixels (2000 x 1440 PNG); help 880 x 740 logical pixels (1760 x 1480 PNG). Full native window extents retained.
processing: Original PNGs retained in raw/. JPEG derivatives use quality 95 and no chroma subsampling; no crop, resize, text replacement or UI retouching. Existing page CSS supplies the frame.
verification: All 23 images visually inspected against their captions and saved accessibility states.
Saved JSON independently verified: eight expected members; updated Bob phone/email; seniors tags on Alex and Irfan.
committee.csv independently verified: Alex, Bob and Charlotte only; four hidden members excluded.
Deletion and both clear images show pending prompts. Each was cancelled after capture; no deletion or clearing was confirmed.
exit-help shows help exit, not execution of exit.
JAR SHA-256 verified before and after capture; no application source or runtime resource changed.
